title: Get in touch
lead: Questions, corrections, partnerships or bug reports. We read everything.

sections.heading: Other ways to reach us
paragraphs: Email [frankoduro1912@gmail.com](mailto:frankoduro1912@gmail.com), or find us on [X](https://x.com/odee_frank), [Instagram](https://instagram.com/_anonymoustroy), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ofrank-design/) and [GitHub](https://github.com/Ofrank-design).

sections.heading: What to include
bullets: For a bug: the page, what you expected, what happened and your device or browser.
For a data correction: the match and what is wrong.
For an account or privacy request: write from the email address on your account so that we can verify it.

sections.heading: Reply times
paragraphs: We usually reply within a few working days.

sections.heading: If you need support
paragraphs: We are not a support service and cannot respond urgently. If gambling is a problem for you or someone you know, see our [responsible use](/responsible-use) page for organisations that can help.
